manual collection CRUD through the real API, visible on the Collections page, gone after delete

another user cannot read or change my collection
pending registration appears on the Admin Users tab; Approve in the UI activates the account; lock/unlock/role change take effect on login
conversion page renders, the real format table matches the page, and a real mp3 to wav job runs to completion on the corpus

suites.title: player in the web UI (real browser, real stream)

specs.title: video: play advances currentTime and the element is fed from /api/v1/stream/:id
audio file: the same player plays an mp3 from the real stream
long playback: plays past the 60 s ticket lifetime, a seek after expiry works, currentTime keeps advancing, no media error
client-side validation: mismatched passwords make no registration request
new user cannot log in until the admin approves, then can
logout: real POST /auth/logout, local session cleared, back on /login, old token revoked server-side
tampered token: real API says 401 and the app drops to /login
a valid session survives a page reload (stays on /dashboard)
a valid session survives a deep link (hard navigation to /media)
no "Disconnected" chip before login (nothing to connect yet)
after login the real socket opens, stays open, receives no close, and the chip is hidden (= connected)
network outage shows the chip (Connecting/Disconnected); recovery reconnects a NEW socket and hides it
